verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has its own event-driven automation. Users configure the risk-score equation and screening configurations. They can subscribe to typed webhooks such as WORKFLOW_COMPLETED that fire outbound callbacks on events. The agentic workflows auto-remediate level 1 alerts and auto-escalate high-risk cases. However, these automations are largely vendor-defined, Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized, and no general user-authored if-event-then-action rule builder is documented. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule engine mapping events to arbitrary actions, user-customizable automation triggers/conditions beyond risk scoring, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
